description:
V00.80.00 (Konzept goal 9) operational-monitoring module. Provides
    framework-neutral export points — JCustosMetricsPublisher and
    JCustosHealthIndicator SPIs plus the security.eventbus.* / auth /
    session metric-name catalog — so production systems can be observed,
    not only tested. No monitoring stack is bundled; only clean export
    points. Skeleton opened with the V00.80.00 release window; sources land
    per implementation prompt.
